_comment: Per-MODULE champion registry for the Ladrillo benchmark. Promotion is manual and
'tag' must have a frozen snapshot under benchmark/reference/<tag>/.
Champions are per module because a change that improves one module and leaves the
others untouched should not silently take credit for them.

ais.why: calib 1.6.0 + CMIP7 driver migration (Marcus 2026-08-28). NOT a fit improvement: R-hat 1.017->1.006, ESS 953->1201, ssp585@2100 AIS 2.430->2.045x lit; but TE hindcast 1.2355x WORSE than BRICK 2.0 (full window, common years 1920-2025, re-referenced 1995-2005; L14 was 0.9875x). Promoted for COHERENCE — L14 is fit to drivers that no longer exist in the tree. ⚠ CORRECTED 2026-08-29: this note previously read 'TE hindcast 1.245x WORSE and AIS 1.142x WORSE'. Neither is reproducible. The bench run that accompanied this promotion (outputs/bench_ladrillo_L21.csv, same minute) has NO L14 arm, and its AIS rmse_ratio/full vs BRICK 2.0 is 0.0265 — far BETTER, not 1.142x worse. The TE ratio is 1.2355, not 1.245. Do not re-quote the withdrawn pair.
